conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Hi, thanks for calling! This is Sarah from technical support. How can I help?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Yeah hi, so my internet's been acting really weird all day. Like it'll work fine for a few minutes then just completely drop. I'm trying to work from home and it's killing my productivity.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: I'm really sorry to hear that. Let me pull up your account here and we'll figure out what's going on.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Okay, I'm seeing some instability on your line. When was the last time you restarted your modem? Sometimes that helps reset things.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Um, I think I restarted it like two days ago? But yeah I can try again right now if you want.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Perfect, that would be really helpful. Just unplug it for 30 seconds, wait a bit, and plug it back in. Let me stay on the line.
